sloka: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यं हनुमान् हरिपुङ्गवः।आपूर्यत बलोद्धर्षैस्तोयवेगैरिवार्णवः ।। ६.७४.३५ ।।
transliteration: śrutvā jāmbavato vākyaṁ hanumān haripuṅgavaḥ।āpūryata baloddharṣaistoyavegairivārṇavaḥ ।। 6.74.35 ।।

translations.english: "Hearing the instruction of Jambavantha, the son of the wind god, infused with wind speed as the ocean, heaves with the force of wind increasing his strength fully."
